title: Used modification RMMV's default Tileset for commercial Game

posts.author: mariov.clanasda
posts.body:
Hello RMMV friends,
Long story short, I designed a RPG maker game and I planned to make them commercial game. I consulted to a publisher and The publisher told me that they want me use more original asset (graphic and audio) instead use the RMMV default asset and AI generated image.
After some consideration, I have an idea to change RMMV default tileset to be less details and older pixelated version.
my plan was to change the graphic style to be more like "
EARTBOUND / MOTHER 2
"
For this plan,  I will use the RMMV default tileset to be my guideline or foundation  then
modify/edit/redraw
them to be new art style tileset.
I do this to save more time so I don't need to redraw maps the current game. Only change  tileset settings in database and voila! old map with RMMV default art style become new map with different art style
my question is it legal to do this especially for commercial game?
if yes, I will do the same thing to character and face.
Best Regards
The sample tileset are below (it's not fix to be used in the game)

posts.body: Just like the many edited assests the community has made, editing the RTP is legal and within the terms of usage.
